notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more creatures.
An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger or Sun Warriors.
description:
Declare Hellkite Charger and Sun Warriors as attackers, triggering each of their abilities.
Resolve the Sun Warrior trigger, adding {R} for each creature you control.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
